_comment: A ring of seven standing stones on a hilltop, one fallen, round a flat altar slab (W8-P). The stones are buried 1.6 m and stand 1.7 m proud, which is why they are 3.3 m tall: a `sink` param does nothing to a block, as W20 found when this ring was moved off the river bank onto ground with half a metre of fall in it and was left hanging in the air. A block reaches as far down as its own base is set, and no further.
name: stone_ring
